issues.description: Animal.messageOnFeed() has inconsistent visibility between the specification and the reference solution: the UML/problem statement defines it as public (students are told to implement it as part of the public API), but the solution declares it as protected abstract in Animal.java. This mismatch can confuse students about the required access modifier and can break tests that expect a public method.
issues.suggestedFix: Align visibility with the UML/spec by changing the solution to `public abstract String messageOnFeed();` in Animal.java and keeping all overrides public.
